payload.release_notes:
- Automatically discover and reconnect to eligible Network PCs. Auto-Sync refreshes the queue, and artwork transfers start with Download.
- Use a larger Roll Preview, saved artwork visibility, and manual per-copy placement and alignment.
- Save verified rolls in TIFF, PDF, PNG, JPEG, BMP, or WebP. TIFF stays the default, and filenames use whole-centimetre dimensions and material.
- Move successfully nested originals into recoverable Deleted Files. Restore keeps each job associated with its exact file.
- Track the print queue from Pending to Successfully, including verified roll archives on another printer.
